style: Dry black ink and matte opaque gouache; bone, moss teal, rust, ochre, indigo and charcoal. Restrained scenery and no particles that obscure play.
rasterTextPolicy: Brand wordmark may be raster. Functional UI and gameplay text are runtime-localized.

proofAnimation.review: Review each frame at native resolution and loop at actual gameplay size. Reject shape morphs, missing limbs, ghosted weapon copies and moving cell boundaries.

proofs.acceptance: Wide finished original illustration with the Grave Accord wordmark.
Seven distinct full-body survivors, stable class identity and equipment, cleaner broad matte coat panels with focal face/hand/prop detail.
Eleven original boss identities with clear silhouettes and scale language.
Top-down Gatehouse composition with quiet floor and readable paths.
Illustrated UI composition with clear health, timer, ammo and ability hierarchy.
Landscape touch HUD with clear controls and safe areas.
Fixed-grid, same-facing eight-frame locomotion proof; inspect frame pivots and cycle in motion.
Fixed-grid, same-facing eight-frame constable attack proof with anticipation, release and recovery.

supplementalProofs.acceptance: Six representative boss identities with broad quiet painted surfaces; this finish proof does not constitute the full sixty-boss sprite library.

backendPolicy: Built-in OpenAI image generation; record model identifier only if actually reported.
